abstract: PURPOSE: We evaluate the indication, technique and long-term outcome of organ preserving tumor resection rather than standard orchiectomy in 73 patients with bilateral testicular germ cell tumors or tumors of a solitary testicle. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Tumor resection was performed in 73 patients with 52 and 17 metachronous and synchronous bilateral testicular germ cell tumors, respectively, and 4 testicular germ cell tumors of a solitary testicle. Histology of the enucleated germ cell tumor revealed seminoma in 42 (57.5%) patients, embryonal carcinoma in 14 (19.2%), mature teratoma in 11 (15.1%), and mixed and combined germ cell tumors in 6 (8.2%). Mean tumor diameter was 15 mm. (range 5 to 30). Associated testicular intraepithelial neoplasia was diagnosed in 82% of patients who underwent local radiation with 18 Gy. RESULTS: After a median followup of 91 months (range 3 to 191) 72 (98.6%) patients had no evidence of disease and 1 died of systemic tumor progression. No local relapse occurred in 46 patients with associated testicular intraepithelial neoplasia treated with local radiation. However, local recurrence did develop in 4 patients after 3, 6, 12 and 165 months without radiation but all survived after undergoing inguinal orchiectomy. Testosterone levels were normal in 62 (84.9%) patients, hypogonadism developed in 7 (9.6%) and preoperative levels remained low in 4 (5.5%). Of the 10 patients who postponed local radiation for paternity reasons 5 had successfully fathered a child after organ sparing surgery. CONCLUSIONS: After a long-term followup of greater than 7 years organ sparing surgery represents a viable therapeutic approach to bilateral testicular germ cell tumor with an excellent postoperative outcome. Tumor enucleation might be considered a standard approach if the guidelines are respected, including cold ischemia, organ confined tumor less than 20 mm., multiple biopsies of the tumor bed, adjuvant local irradiation postoperatively to avoid local recurrence, close followup and high compliance.
abstract_ja: 目的：両側精巣腫瘍または単独精巣の腫瘍を有する73例において、精巣摘除術に代わる臓器温存的腫瘍切除の適応、手技、長期成績を評価した。材料と方法：異時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍52例、同時性両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍17例、単独精巣の精巣胚細胞腫瘍4例に対して腫瘍切除を施行した。摘出された胚細胞腫瘍の組織型は、セミノーマ42例（57.5%）、胎児性癌14例（19.2%）、成熟奇形腫11例（15.1%）、混合性および複合性胚細胞腫瘍6例（8.2%）であった。平均腫瘍径は15mm（5〜30mm）。精巣上皮内腫瘍を伴った症例の82%には、術後に18Gyの局所放射線照射を行った。結果：中央値91か月（3〜191か月）の追跡で、72例（98.6%）が無病生存し、1例は全身性腫瘍進行で死亡した。精巣上皮内腫瘍を伴い局所放射線照射を施行した46例では局所再発は認めなかった。一方、放射線照射を行わなかった4例では3、6、12、165か月後に局所再発を生じたが、いずれも鼠径部精巣摘除術により救命された。テストステロン値は62例（84.9%）で正常、7例（9.6%）で性腺機能低下症、4例（5.5%）は術前から低値のままであった。挙児希望のため局所放射線照射を延期した10例のうち5例が、臓器温存手術後に子どもをもうけた。結論：7年を超える長期追跡の結果、臓器温存手術は両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する有効な治療法であり、術後成績も良好である。冷虚血、腫瘍床の複数生検、術後局所照射による局所再発の予防、綿密な経過観察、高い遵守率といった条件を守れば、腫瘍核出術は標準的な選択肢となりうる。
